method.mechanism: One exact approved GitHub connector fetch_file read, requested in base64 to preserve source file bytes
method.verification: Actual Node CI recomputes Git object SHA1 and file SHA256; reject size/hash mismatch
method.transport_limitations: Connector owns HTTP transport and exposes decoded file bytes/metadata, not raw HTTP bodies, status, headers or robots receipts; no website crawler or independent transport verification is claimed

scope.framework: Only explicitly bound native provider framework/thresholds; no guessed framework edition/domain slots or cross-provider scale mapping
scope.statements: Provider-reported determinations separated from supporting assessments and deployment safeguards; no independent model evaluation
scope.temporal: Current pinned Git bytes do not establish release date, historical availability or launch-edition identity

stop_condition: One exact artifact read; stop with explicit primary/framework evidence gap if unavailable or unsupported. No retries, alternate artifacts, website/PDF fetching, inference/model API, other provider, external outreach, upstream change or main merge.
